license_note: Both the code repository and the model weights are released under the Kimi K3 License, an in-repository license file reproducing an MIT-style grant expanded to weights, parameters, configs, and inference and training code. It requires operators of a model-as-a-service business above 20 million US dollars in aggregate affiliate revenue over any consecutive twelve months to sign a separate agreement before any commercial use, and requires prominent Kimi K3 attribution above 100 million monthly active users or 20 million US dollars in monthly revenue. Those commercial gates go beyond the Kimi K2 Modified MIT text, so the release is source-available rather than open source.

license_evidence.scope: moonshotai/Kimi-K3 repository code, model weights, parameters, configuration files, inference and training code, and documentation, including derivative works

access_boundary: This record represents the moonshotai/Kimi-K3 repository release with native MXFP4 weights. The Kimi K2 family, Kimi K2.5, K2.6, and K2.7-Code, the Kimi API and platform products, and downstream requantizations remain separate boundaries.
strengths: Developer-published full weights with modeling and processor code and an in-repository license file, plus vLLM, SGLang, and TokenSpeed deployment recipes
The first-party platform quickstart documents kimi-k3 API access with vision, reasoning-effort, and tool-calling guides, and Together AI documents independent serverless hosting
tradeoffs: The Kimi K3 License adds a model-as-a-service revenue gate requiring a separate agreement before any commercial use, so the weights are source-available rather than open source
Practical self-operation targets supernode-class hardware and requires trusted remote code
